formal_title: Interaction-Law Domain Escape, Non-Bot Software Transport, Compatibility×Coexistence Factorial Replication, Higher-Order Support Acquisition, Geometry-Conditioned Policy Generalization, Harvest Backflow Evaluation & Interaction-Law Stress

research_program.macro_goal: Recover a representation-stable, cross-domain law of software design and change in which familiar design doctrines such as SOLID may eventually appear as local special cases rather than primitives.
research_program.p18_role: Attack the current bot/workflow concentration and determine whether interaction structure survives in non-bot software mechanisms.

primary_targets.reason: P17 left this as the strongest one-domain non-bot candidate.

primary_targets.role: P17 transported reference edge; not the main novelty target.

domain_escape_requirement.promotion_threshold: At least one exact matched non-bot factorial family plus an independent second family transporting the same semantic interaction.

factorial_identification.pairwise: Complete or intervention-equivalent 2x2 family under fixed material G and E. Joint action must reject every main-effect-only reconstruction.
factorial_identification.three_way_X: Require all lower-order cells needed to reject every pairwise model under fixed G,E.
factorial_identification.four_way_X: Require all lower-order reconstructions to fail under a complete or logically complete intervention family.
factorial_identification.natural_boolean_gate_rule: Source-level guards may instantiate factorial cells only when each branch has stable operational semantics and is not inferred post hoc.

geometry_conditioned_generalization.question: Does an interaction survive when G changes but semantic primitive coordinates remain fixed?

higher_order_support.goal: Actively seek but do not force genuine three- or four-X support.
higher_order_support.promotion: Only prospectively frozen complete support may authorize a higher-order X term.
higher_order_support.negative_result: Failure to find complete support is a valid scientific result and Harvest donor.

harvest_parallel_lineage.paper_rule: Prepare paper-readiness evidence, figures, claims and related-work structure, but do not draft a submission manuscript or freeze a paper thesis in P18.

language_plan.principle: Continue reducing Python as default implementation language; choose language by mechanism rather than aesthetics.
language_plan.requirement: At least three non-Python executable lanes, with at least one language not used by P17 if implementation proceeds.

r2_gate: LAW-R2 may reopen only if a fresh materially normalized same-(X,G,E) action conflict survives all admissible interaction, geometry, representation, and provenance reconstruction.
